During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''stormtrooper''' chased the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] through a canyon on a [[Unidentified planet (trinary system)|planet]] in a [[Star system/Legends|trinary system]]. The pair battled through the canyon, with the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] attempting to ram Garnet's speeder bike into the canyon wall. Garnet responded in kind, forcing the stormtroopers' bike into a crash.<ref name="RPG" />
